column1: # Comment and blank lines are inert: the parser keys on field 1 via `cut -f1 | grep -qx`,
# which no gate name can match on a "#"-prefixed or empty line (verified empirically).
# Every row below is a gate NAMED in the governance corpus that is NOT yet implemented in an
# executable gate site. Per §11.4.227(A) silent gate debt is forbidden, and per §11.4 a gate
# invented so it cannot FAIL would itself be the bluff - so each is registered as owed debt
# against a tracked item in docs/owed_gate_implementations.md, never faked and never deleted.
#   OWED-GATE-NNN    a real gate whose harness is genuinely owed (64 rows)
#   OWED-NAMING-NNN  a token-extraction ARTIFACT, not a real gate name (8 rows) - deferred
#                    rather than removed because gate_ledger_removals.tsv provably cannot
#                    cover a token that is still PRESENT in the corpus (removals are only
#                    consulted in check-mode for names ABSENT from the ledger).
